Hoop World: Dunking Games

Hoop World: Dunking Games
THE ULTIMATE FLIP & DUNK GAME!
Jump and dunk your way through mind-bending portals in an epic adventure!

Have you ever pulled off a triple front flip dunk while traveling through a portal to a new world? Hoop World is the ultimate, most addictive basketball game with the simplest controls and coolest graphics!

Playing is easy but mastering is not! Can you unlock all the exciting levels?

Hoop World: Dunking Games
Unleash your basketball skills. Shoot hoops. Make mind-blowing slam dunks. Flip more for more points. Jump through rooftops, trampolines, slides and more. Be careful not to fall and break your neck! Complete your journey through amazing portals and discover super cool environments! 

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
HOW TO PLAY 

Easy to learn - 1 finger control:

Tap to Jump & Hold to Flip & Release to Dunk!
